headline: Undetected: forged route hijacked the Celer Bridge frontend
text: LegitAS announced a more-specific route to AWS's Celer Bridge address, forging the path so it looked like it came from AWS and passed RPKI checks. Tier1, TransitAS, ISP and TinyInc all accepted and spread it; traffic for the frontend was quietly captured by LegitAS. Warning signs (a looping path, an odd shorter route) were noticed but dismissed, and no one asked AWS directly, so the hijack held unresolved.
